failed_approaches.summary: The initial Arrow string-length probe supplied an obsolete offset generic; arrow-string 58.4.0 exposes a non-generic length(&dyn Array) API. The probe was corrected to the exact pinned API.

The first utility probe constructed and dropped an owned Tokio runtime inside an async test. The probe now uses the ambient runtime handle, preserving the Tokio compatibility check without an invalid nested-runtime lifecycle.
The first zsh loop used the reserved special array name path, overwriting PATH and making shasum/awk unresolvable. Renaming it to file_path made the identical integrity check pass.

WP02 follows its explicit change-surface/rollback rule and remains directory-local. The contradictory outcome sentence about root docs is treated as an M01 integration result owned by WP05.

On macOS, a bare rustc_private binary needs the pinned sysroot lib directory in DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH. Cargo supplies it for cargo run/test; WP05 must encode the production/CI launcher environment explicitly.

failed_approaches.summary: The bare macOS process aborted because librustc_driver is compiler-shipped and no LC_RPATH is embedded. cargo run and direct launch with DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH set to the pinned sysroot lib both pass.

rustfmt requested three mechanical layouts; Clippy then identified value-hiding empty assertions plus unnested-or-patterns inside rustc_public::run!. Formatting and assertions were corrected, and the upstream-macro lint has one reason-scoped suppression.

The crates.io 1.2.0 coordinate does not exist. The manifest pins release-tag commit 1933169ad8ee9e4d4114112eb56ef0811fb0a094 by exact rev plus version =1.2.0, strengthening the plan's git-tag option against tag movement.

failed_approaches.summary: The first resolution attempt preceded creation of a Cargo target, so Cargo rejected the targetless manifest. Adding the planned sidecar source allowed lock generation.
Cargo-deny treats git dependencies without a version key as wildcard declarations even with immutable revs. Adding exact version =1.2.0 constraints made bans pass without weakening wildcard policy.

Ripgrep's default engine rejected a lookahead and the shell conditional incorrectly treated that diagnostic as a clean absence. Replaced it with cargo metadata plus jq exact-version evaluation, which proved every Ruff component is 0.0.6.

The first generator invocation omitted the vendored include path and later used rustfmt's edition default. The generator now passes protoc-bin-vendored's include root and invokes rustfmt explicitly with edition 2024.

failed_approaches.command: initial tonic UDS connector and test socket
failed_approaches.summary: Tokio UnixStream needed hyper-util TokioIo for tonic's Hyper connector, and a long macOS temporary path exceeded the Unix-socket limit. The harness now adapts the stream and uses a short unique per-test /tmp root.
Pyrefly could not discover generated message attributes without a stub. grpcio-tools now emits and commits the matching .pyi output.

An inner allow attribute prepended to an include! file was invalid and temporarily made the generator unable to compile its host library. The stale line was removed and a narrow allow now sits on the generated module boundary.

Clippy rejected two unnecessarily async test helpers; cargo-machete descended into the intentional duplicate fixture; cargo-shear treated generated-only prost references as unused. Helpers are synchronous, .ignore separates generated/negative fixtures, test-only crates moved to dev-dependencies, and the two generated runtime crates carry an owner/expiry scanner exception.
The literal retirement patterns caused the checker to match its own implementation. Fragmented search tokens preserve the zero-state assertion without self-matching.
The first ripgrep lookahead was unsupported and sat in a conditional that masked the parser error. The corrected assertion uses an awk shape check; all action pins are 40-hex commits.

deviations.summary: The original v4 WP06 mechanics are superseded by the model-based typed catalog, bounded ingress, dual identities, independent KATs, and packaged artifact index; schema-1 recorded no proving commit.

The user approved six cache/build changes during WP06: capability feature isolation; narrow contract/proto/fuzz selection; stable root-sidecar target sharing; separate extractor/nightly/fuzz roots with native fuzz targeting; host-global sccache ownership; and CI incremental disablement plus exact graph governance.

The JCS boundary now validates the emitted canonical number token, not only the parsed input representation, because serde_json_canonicalizer can round a fractional input to an integer outside the interoperable domain. Rust and Python share the new negative vector.

AC-G-05 now explicitly owns the YAML 1.1 to AC-G-53 projection decisions used by production code. This narrows previously implicit YAML-only behavior without changing the codefabric-jcs-v1 JSON contract or packet dependencies.

failed_approaches.summary: The fuzz path dependency resolved the complete 517-package product graph and paid 22m59s of unrelated compilation. Capability isolation reduces the fuzz graph to 32 packages.

failed_approaches.command: initial native fuzz campaign after feature isolation
failed_approaches.summary: Fuzzing found decimal 909009254740799291.99 canonicalizing to an unsafe integer token that replay rejected. Validation now checks both ingress and emitted number tokens; the bounded rerun passed.

Clippy found one needless raw-string delimiter and four renderer quality findings. The literal was simplified and the renderer was split into cohesive helpers using direct String formatting; the exact gates and byte-reproducibility reran green.

Crates.io lacks Pyrefly 1.2.0. The selected source is exact version 1.2.0 at immutable commit 1933169ad8ee9e4d4114112eb56ef0811fb0a094; the locked source digest is 1b9e72144644d1b3df0bdca564496566238543dfb7f576980a8408714327fc3e.

Narrow tools must select capability features with default features disabled. The exact graph, not target-directory size or cache hits, is the correctness oracle; stable target sharing and sccache are acceleration only.

RFC 8785 serialization can round an accepted fractional input into an integer token outside CodeFabric's interoperable integer domain. Canonicalization must validate the emitted token before returning bytes in both Rust and Python.

AC-G-05 now defines a single-document YAML 1.1 subset and explicit projection into AC-G-53 values. The pinned parser's duplicate, document-count, and nesting behavior is tested; tags and merge keys are rejected; aliases resolve semantically; non-string maps become sorted records.

plan_deviations.summary: The v4 and remediation schema-1 ledgers remain immutable declared-input provenance. Their still-relevant packet judgments and accepted deviations are carried into this schema-2 ledger without derived digests, changed-file inventories, check output, or cached HEAD facts.
The model-based remediation plan was user-accepted and executed despite its immutable historical draft frontmatter.
Ubuntu clean-checkout evidence is user-deferred. Local macOS evidence remains required and no unsupported platform claim is inferred.
Tracked auxiliary Cargo target files were removed from the current tree and reachable HEAD history before v5 adoption; DB06 is a permanent reintroduction guard.
Machine projections omit only their own root/header identities, retain nested identities, and normative prose uses prose-utf8-v1.
source_digest is detached index provenance because complete source bytes cannot embed their own exact digest without self-reference.
The governed YAML subset rejects anchors, aliases, tags, and merges before materialization; EBNF validates a bounded dialect and projects its LF-normalized payload.
The canonical artifact index resides under the adapter module root so importlib.resources and Rust include_bytes consume identical bytes.
Proof-coverage equivalence and boundary-focused timing replaced unrelated clean Cargo rebuild timing; v5 makes no cold-build performance claim.
AC-G-07 bundles use closed typed records and shared typed projection seams; production member population remains WP11.

failed_approaches: The first mutation attempt used a nonexistent contracts-generate recipe; just --list identified the confirm-gated contracts-gen command.

The preexisting two-root script copied only contracts/, so catalog-governed prose authorities were absent; it now copies both authorities and compares outputs solely through catalog edges.
serde_yaml_ng exposes no configurable pre-expansion alias cap, so the accepted subset rejects anchors and aliases before materialization.
The initial split-on-semicolon EBNF check was insufficient; it was replaced by a bounded tokenizer and recursive dialect parser.

Comparing a reordered catalog's full artifact-index bytes incorrectly ignored the required source_digest change; the reproduction oracle now separates unchanged-root byte reproducibility from reorder semantic invariance.
A direct prost-build dependency was retained initially but became redundant once tonic-prost-build compile_fds owned generation; it and the obsolete scanner exception were removed.
The loopback deadline probe can report either Cancelled or DeadlineExceeded at the local transport race boundary; the assertion now accepts exactly those two defined cancellation outcomes.
The tooling test import root was not visible under the adapter pytest rootdir until the recipe explicitly set PYTHONPATH=. for tooling/proto tests.
Importing FastMCP's concrete Tool class into the contract fingerprint module violated the framework-boundary structural rule; a protocol-facing structural Protocol now depends only on mcp.types.Tool.
